mabUpstreamMetrics.method: Preserved upstream functions and family postprocessing; no ROUGE or complete official evaluator/leaderboard.

embeddingExecution: Serial local batches16,requestedCPU-only num_gpu0/num_thread1; exact real model-digest/role/text-keyed original seed cache reused read-only; overlay commits once per fresh batch.

embeddingTruncation.definition: Batch bounds only. Cached vectors retain conservative original batch truncation flags; no per-chunk truncation rate.

profiles.cooldown: 60 seconds doubling for consecutive429, capped300s; honor a longer supplied Retry-After.
profiles.checkpoint: Create-only atomic link after JSON/file fsync, followed by directory fsync. Progress is best-effort; completed result files are authoritative. Not a hardware power-loss guarantee.
profiles.semantics: Only benchmark checkpoint publication and HTTP admission/cooldown change. Model, prompt, reasoning, output cap, keys and frozen driver are unchanged. Existing valid answers are reused regardless of correctness.

transportRecovery.latencyDefinition: Attempt wall time includes admission/cooldown in wrapper runs and transport-receipt publication overhead in durable runs. Separate wrapper HTTP and slot/gate times are recorded; earlier runs used HTTP/decode wall time without this wrapper. Failed HTTP calls without a response have no separate transport observation. These are service observations, not paired speed claims.

cost: Currency cost not available; usage not converted to assumed prices.
limitations: Small25+25 balanced fresh query-heldout pilot, shared corpora/questions across source families; not independent population samples or official leaderboard.
Same-model self-judging and hosted serving version not independently pinned; controls do not establish human agreement.
Candidate changes both excerpt selection and default excerpt allowance 1800 to6000; measured gain cannot be attributed to only one.
Record96 and97 scores belong to different subsets and candidates; compare only the fresh paired25-question per-dataset denominators.
Embedding truncation is explicit; no reranker. Public timings are shared-machine/service observations, not qualified speed ratios.
Interrupted in-flight calls without a returned record have unknown usage; every recorded attempt and all valid answers are retained.
Accepted-attempt latency excludes earlier failed attempts/backoff. Wrapper admission/cooldown is separated where instrumented; no end-to-end speedup or energy claim.

adoption.rule: Require positive paired net accuracy in both datasets plus zero provenance/scope/budget/required-contract failures. Report losses and declining strata; no release qualification.
